name: The Blessing of Airon
storyline: Follow the tale of a Tactically Trained Clergy member as he seeks to rescue some wayward young lads in the world of The Blessing of Airon. In The Blessing of Airon, hundreds of years have passed since the present day and its terrible events. Powerful smart phones, computers and any computing device capable of running a neural network on its hardware can be influenced by the demonic forces of the world. Some of these items are nearly indestructible, and they have haunted humanity for centuries by this point. Still, the allure of using these terrible devices remains. What happens when they give in to this temptation? Who will save them?
summary: The Blessing of Airon is a First Person Story Adventure (Walking Sim) telling the story of a society which has lost access to all electronic devices capable of processing a neural network due to demon infestation. It is a horror game which focuses on exploration and uncovering mysterious events through a large variety of inspectable items with story text, custom sounds and vfx.
